pages.title: Magical Girl
pages.text:
Sparkling gear for a hero who transforms.

- **Tier:** Diamond
- **Durability:** 1500
- **Sword damage:** 7
- **Armor (full set):** 20

pages.title: Getting It
pages.text: In the [Alloy Forge](entry://alloy_forge/alloy_forge), 1 diamond, 2 amethyst shards, and 2 glowstone dust make 1 Sparkle Gem.

pages.title: The Gear
pages.text:
- **Gear:** about diamond's strength. The armor glows faintly.
- **Sparkle Beam:** at full health, a fully charged swing with a magical girl weapon also fires a beam of light that deals 4 damage to every mob in a line up to 8 blocks ahead.
- **Barrier:** arrows and other projectiles blocked by the magical girl shield bounce straight back at whoever shot them.

pages.title: Transformation
pages.text:
**Full set bonus.** Unlocks the **Transform** ability.

**Transform (R):** for 30 seconds you get Strength, Speed, Resistance, and Slow Falling, wrapped in sparkles. It can be used again after 5 minutes.
